verdictSemantics.PASS: the recipe's actions executed (execution count > 0) and every expected outcome was met against live observation. This attests the DECLARED CONSTRUCTION SCOPE only: the real-CLI R-to-V role slice, the P2_5 consensus/test-design consumption contract, and the recipe/registration tracking of the full step plan. It NEVER asserts the full same-run terminal state — steps 7-11 (Kp, real OpenSpec archive, Outline unknown-result/restart recovery, Kt, completed) are execution_owner=VERIFY (execution-contract journey_execution); recipe validation alone does not close E01/E02/E06.
verdictSemantics.FAIL: the declared construction scope executed and the observed outcome contradicted the frozen THEN (a slice negative passed when it must refuse, a dispatch binding was accepted without its evidence, the recipe/registration binding drifted, or the case module reported failures)
verdictSemantics.NOT-EXERCISED: a prerequisite was missing (registered recipe, schema-valid definition, frozen pilot baseline, identity or environment — e.g. the patched Comet build d4370930 is absent); structured refusal with nonzero exit, never converted into a pass
verdictSemantics.NOT-APPLICABLE: explicitly out of scope for the registered profile with a recorded reason; still nonzero; the runner never self-assigns it
